display.entryTitle: Deer Wall Designer Initials, Second Pair

description: Farther along the same semicircular wall, a second pair of the lead designer's initials is worked into the brick and plaster.

whereToLook.scene: Semicircular wall at the deer viewing area
whereToLook.exactSpot: Continue along the wall from the first pair. The second is farther toward the right end.

bestTip: Once you know what the first pair looks like, the second is easier.
